training.algorithm: original core.train_branch unchanged; Adam 0.006, batch64, max20000, first checkpoint every25 with target accuracy>=.99
training.pairing: identical initialization and minibatch stream prefix; same maximum budget and stopping criterion, realized stopping steps can differ
training.j0_replay_gate: same stopping steps and accuracies, maximum absolute parameter error <=1e-12; exact equality recorded

reuse: j0: verified B8 six-source results, not B4/B5 estimates
area_gate: abs(calibrated_area/0.02-1)<=1e-6, exactly as B8; centroid-sum errors reported separately, not a new relaxed or tightened gate
primary_unit: split; descriptive repeated train/test partitions share Wine examples, so independent-replicate interpretation is conditional on fixed dataset
split_aggregate: median of the five signed true-minus-random contrasts
sign_test: exact two-sided binomial sign test on 8 split medians; exact zeros omitted; report effective n; six spatial p-values also Holm-adjusted as fixed family

bootstrap.tie_handling: scipy BCa default; nonfinite/degenerate CI => unavailable, do not substitute another CI method

heterogeneity: direction counts and medians separately by init index
two-way additive decomposition of 8x5 signed contrasts; residual labeled interaction-plus-unreplicated-error, no separable inferential interaction test
magnitude_independence: normalized spatial estimands are invariant to multiplicative K scaling analytically; empirical rank correlations with log C_A within regime and split-level contrasts descriptive; no causal/statistical independence inferred from normalization
exclusions: exclude whole pair if either state fails any inherited gate or training replay/eligibility; no replacement seeds
failure_policy: Any excluded pair prevents confirmatory PASS of full 40-pair panel; label families INCONCLUSIVE, retain descriptive valid pairs and incomplete-split flags; no survivor-only confirmation
family_decision: With all 40 valid pairs: metric PASS if all 8 split medians have expected strict sign and exact two-sided p<0.05; otherwise FAIL for that directional criterion, never proof of null; report Holm across six spatial metrics. Magnitude=C_A, localization=all five normalized metrics. A failed/unavailable BCa is reported, not a posthoc new gate.
depth: C1-B separate: original seven nonempty coalitions, full-state D0.02 and full metric area measure; v(empty)=0, Shapley of coalition C_A, absolute shares, H_phi=sum shares^2, s3=share of output. No central-point or singleton substitute. Assess runtime after C1-A; if complete 7-field x80 x6 evaluation is infeasible, retain C1-B pending/INCONCLUSIVE and do not claim depth survived.
continuation: C2 only if C1 numerical gates and directional evidence robust; do not claim completed joint mechanism if depth remains unresolved. No external-task replication in this run.
